**Verdict:** `needs_changes`

### Findings
- **[blocker] `packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx:55`** —
  - **Issue:** `useState` + `useEffect` fails U01 (`createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`: `'Root link: /my-page'` is not found) because `rerender(finalizedApp.element)` runs on React's `DefaultLane` and mounts `<NotFoundErrorPage />` (`React.lazy(async () => ...)` in `DefaultSwappableComponentsApi`) inside `app/root`'s `<Suspense>` boundary, suspending that `DefaultLane` render before it can commit; a `useState` update gets merged into that suspended `DefaultLane` pass and never commits synchronously. Conversely, `useSyncExternalStore` schedules its store notification on `SyncLane` (which flushes and commits `'Root link: /my-page'` before `DefaultLane` suspends), but calling `useApi(routeResolutionApiRef)` on every render leaves `RootElement`'s fiber subscribed to `ApiContext`, which `<ApiProvider>` invalidates on `DefaultLane` via an unmemoized `createVersionedValueMap({ 1: holder })`, causing a 3rd render (`renderCount = 3` instead of `2`).
  - **Fix:** Restore `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot)` per `change_plan.md` U04 (with `subscribe` and `getSnapshot` memoized via `useMemo` on `[routeResolutionApi]`, and `snapshot` included in the `routeFunc` `useMemo` dependency array alongside `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`), and read `routeResolutionApi` once via a lazy `useState` initializer (`import { routeResolutionApiRef, RouteRef, SubRouteRef, ExternalRouteRef, useApi as getApi } from '../apis';` and `const [routeResolutionApi] = useState(() => getApi(routeResolutionApiRef));`) so the `SyncLane` re-render clears the fiber's `ApiContext` dependency and allows React to bail out on `<RootElement />` during `rerender(finalizedApp.element)`'s `DefaultLane` pass, keeping `renderCount` at 2.

### Passing Checks
- `packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx`: Correctly implements `#listeners`, `subscribe`, `getSnapshot`, and notifies listeners in `initialize`.
- `packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`: Reproducing test U01 matches `change_plan.md`.
- `packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.test.tsx`: Reproducing test U02 passes (8/8) and matches `change_plan.md`.
- `.changeset/routeref-startup-resolution.md`, `docs/frontend-system/architecture/36-routes.md`, `docs/frontend-system/building-apps/03-built-in-extensions.md`: Changeset and documentation updates match `change_plan.md`.
- Typecheck, lint, and API reports (`yarn tsc`, `yarn lint:all`, `yarn build:api-reports`): All pass.
